Goal (pinned, verbatim from the approved spec):
Migrate every component under packages/ui to Vue 3.

Non-goals:
- Do not touch packages/legacy.

Acceptance criteria (pinned, verbatim from the approved spec):
- ac-1: pnpm typecheck passes.
- ac-2: Every component renders.

Safety constraints (pinned):
- No new runtime dependency.
